title: Re-extraction command
acceptance: Rebuilds blocks from stored original HTML for one post and for the whole library
Highlights survive re-extraction or the user is warned before any are lost
Posts with no stored HTML are skipped, not corrupted
The operation is cancellable and reports what changed
notes: Constitution P7: must not lossily rewrite the archive.

history.detail: dropped stale Stacks/Content/** and narrowed Stacks/Views/** to the two files needing an entry point, so it does not collide with T-0022's reader typography lease
code-review: overlapping matches make the exactly-once uniqueness guarantee false (silent misplacement); destructive drop path never accounts for deleted highlights; progress off by one
